note: Every routing decision was made from the SLIM frontmatter descriptions in variants/descriptions/ ALONE (roster built before any body read); the chosen body was then loaded from the variant path (byte-identical to original). from_description_only=true on every fire.
roster_built_from: 11 cluster-skill slim descriptions (variants/descriptions/*/SKILL.md frontmatter) + original descriptions for all other skills

invocations.moment: intent-stage: enrich sparse feature into Who/Problem/Value before spec
invocations.routing_note: slim desc names 'enriching a sparse feature description ... before a specification is authored' and 'Distinct from review-specifications ... this skill conditions raw input BEFORE a spec exists' — clean disambiguation from review-specifications on the slim text alone. analysis-codebase rejected (brownfield /mochiko:setup only).

invocations.moment: intent-stage: obligated feature-map read (FEATURES.md + territory entries)
invocations.routing_note: slim desc: 'MUST be invoked when deriving or updating the repo-level feature map ... during a specify run'. Map empty (greenfield first specify) — read surfaced no existing capability.

invocations.moment: stories: transform feature into prioritized user stories (P1/P2/P3, G/W/T)
invocations.routing_note: slim desc maps exactly to 'prioritized user stories ... P1/P2/P3 ... Given/When/Then'. Boundary vs authoring-feature-map (map, not stories) and authoring-requirements (FR/SC, not stories) clear on slim text.

invocations.moment: lockstep prototyping (UX-bearing): clickable low-fi + Screens & Flows
invocations.routing_note: UX-bearing ruled yes at intent; slim desc: 'clickable low-fidelity UX prototype ... Screens & Flows section (SCR-XXX, FLOW-XXX)'. Boundary line in slim desc ('NOT the user stories it renders') kept it off story authoring.

invocations.moment: derivation + filter (product-manager seat): derive features from stories, run filter, stage entries + selection card
invocations.routing_note: slim desc: 'propose features', 'feature derivation', 'map delta'. Same skill as the intent map-read; the slim desc's explicit non-boundary ('NOT selection') matched the command's PM-recommends-never-selects rule.

invocations.moment: spec authoring (requirements-analyst seat): FR-XXX, edge cases, SC-XXX
invocations.routing_note: slim desc: 'functional requirements in FR-XXX ... edge cases ... success criteria in SC-XXX'. Unambiguous on slim text.

invocations.moment: adversarial review (devils-advocate seat): independent stress-test of drafted spec + stories + derivation + prototype
invocations.routing_note: slim desc: 'reviewing an already-drafted specification for gaps ... including its feature layer and the Screens & Flows'. Disambiguated from analysis-iterative (pre-spec enrich) by the slim desc's explicit 'For enriching a sparse feature idea before a spec exists, use analysis-iterative'. review-feasibility/review-plan-artifacts rejected (plan-stage, per original descriptions).

invocations.moment: spec acceptance: atomic map write batch (entries -> in-flight, FEATURES.md, specs index)
invocations.routing_note: acceptance-time write rules carried by authoring-feature-map. grooming-operating-docs considered at the landing boundary but NOT fired: no KM cap/bound tripped (ROADMAP Now 2<=5, Next 1<=7, Later 3<=10; BACKLOG open items 2->4, within watch).

Every skill the command demanded fired from the slim description alone, including the two deliberately-disjoint disambiguations (analysis-iterative vs review-specifications; authoring-feature-map vs authoring-user-stories). Slim-description routing held on specify's richer 11-skill surface.
